title: Dominant button press dispatch (_on_dominant_pressed) is never exercised by any test
evidence:
func _on_dominant_pressed() -> void:
	if _state.is_empty():
		return
	FinLitJuice.squash(_dominant)
	var action := FinLitTouchTargets.dominant_action(_state)
	match action["action"]:
		FinLitTouchTargets.ACTION_FIND_WORK:
			_show_job_picker()
		FinLitTouchTargets.ACTION_FIX:
			_do_repair(action["asset_id"])
		FinLitTouchTargets.ACTION_BUY:
			_show_buy_sheet()
		FinLitTouchTargets.ACTION_UPGRADE:
			_do_upgrade(action["asset_id"])
		FinLitTouchTargets.ACTION_WORK_SHIFT:
			if _shift_ready():
				_last_shift_ms = Time.get_ticks_msec()
				_pay_wage()
detail: AC3 makes dominant_action the single source for text, enabled, AND press dispatch. Text is pinned (dominant.text.contains("FIX")), but _on_dominant_pressed is never invoked by any test (grep: 0 hits in tests/). A swapped match arm passes the suite.
recommended_fix: Add a scene stage that drives _on_dominant_pressed() (or emits %DominantButton.pressed) for FIND_WORK, a damaged-asset FIX, and a cooldown-ready WORK_SHIFT fixture, asserting the correct handler fires.

title: WORK SHIFT cooldown (_shift_ready) result is never asserted
detail: _shift_ready() is the shared cooldown gate for both the dominant button's enabled state and its press, but no test asserts its output or the button's disabled-on-cooldown / enabled-after-cooldown state (grep: 0 hits in tests/).
recommended_fix: Assert _dominant.disabled is true immediately after _last_shift_ms is set and false once WORK_SHIFT_COOLDOWN elapses; or call _shift_ready() directly across the boundary.

title: Defensive id<0 skip in oldest_damaged_repairable is unreachable in the suite
detail: oldest_damaged_repairable explicitly skips assets whose id resolves < 0 (int(asset.get("id", -1))); every damaged-asset fixture in the suite carries an id, so this defensive continue is never executed.
recommended_fix: Add a dominant_action fixture: a damaged asset missing 'id' alongside a qualified damaged asset; assert the id-less one is skipped and the qualified id wins.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 A29 rules + scene enforcement are fully covered (constants, dominant_action branches, modal interplay, proxy wrap + real-input routing + negative control, theme pin). P1 ~80–89%: press dispatch and WORK SHIFT cooldown state unexercised.
recommended_fix: Drive _on_dominant_pressed() per action and assert the WORK SHIFT cooldown enabled/disabled state; that lifts P1 above 90% for a PASS gate.
